title: Cam Skattebo thought about walking away from football after ankle injury

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Cam Skattebo thought about walking away from football after ankle injury
sources.description: Giants running back Cam Skattebo is set to make his return to the lineup in Week 1, but it wasn't always a sure thing in his mind that he'd return after dislocating his right ankle in the seventh game of his rookie season.
